    Strain: 

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • Measure of deformation (Δl) experienced by the body in the direction of force applied, divided by initial dimensions (l) of the body is called strain.
      • \n\t
    • ϵ = Δl/lΔl
      • \n
    \n\n

    \n\n

    Stress-Strain Curve: 

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • The stress-strain curve for a material gives the relationship between change in stress and change in strain.
      • \n\t
    • Experimentally, It is obtained by gradually applying a load to the system.
      • \n\t
    • The ratio of stress and strain gives Young's modulus of elasticity. 
      • \n\t
      • \n\t
    • \n\t

      Limit of proportionality is the stress at which the stress-strain curve ceases to be a straight line. It is the stress at which extension ceases to be proportional to strain. The proportional limit is important because all subsequent theory involving the behavior of elastic bodies is based on the stress-strain proportionality.

      \n\n\t

      Elastic limit is is that point in the stress-strain curve up to which the material remains elastic, i.e. the material regains its shape after the removal of the load.

    हुक का नियम:

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • इसमें कहा गया है कि प्रत्यक्ष भारण के तहत, आनुपातिकता सीमा के भीतर, प्रतिबल विकृति के अनुक्रमानुपाती होता है।
      • \n\t
    • हुक का नियम हमें यह समझने में मदद करता है कि खिंचाव या संहत होने पर एक खिंचाव वाली वस्तु कैसे व्यवहार करेगी।
      • \n
    \n\n
      \n\t
      • \n
    \n\n

    प्रतिबल ∝ विकृति 

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • σ = E × ∈
      • \n\t
    • जहां σ प्रतिबल है, ∈ विकृति है, E आनुपातिकता का एक स्थिरांक है और यंग के प्रत्यास्थता गुणांक के रूप में जाना जाता है।
      • \n
    \n\n

    यंग का प्रत्यास्थता गुणांक

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • प्रतिबल-विकृति वक्र की प्रवणता को प्रत्यास्थता गुणांक (E) कहा जाता है।
      • \n\t
    • प्रत्यास्थता गुणांक (E) आनुपातिकता का स्थिरांक है जिसे प्रतिबल की तीव्रता के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है जो इकाई विकृति का कारण बनता है।
      • \n\t
    • प्रत्यास्थता गुणांक (E) की इकाई प्रतिबल के समान होती है।
      • \n
    \n\n

    हुक का नियम सीमा आनुपातिकता तक मान्य है।

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • हल्के स्टील के लिए आनुपातिक सीमा और प्रत्यास्थता सीमा लगभग बराबर है।
      • \n\t
    • अन्य धातुओं के लिए, प्रत्यास्थता सीमा आनुपातिकता सीमा से अधिक हो सकती है। उदाहरण के लिए रबर।
      • \n
    \n\n

    विकृति: 

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • बल की दिशा में निकाय द्वारा अनुभव किए गए विरूपण (l) की माप का निकाय के प्रारंभिक आयामों (Δl) द्वारा विभाजन, विकृति कहा जाता है।
      • \n\t
    • ε = Δl/llΔl
      • \n
    \n\n

    \n\n

    प्रतिबल-विकृति वक्र:

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • एक सामग्री के लिए प्रतिबल-विकृति वक्र प्रतिबल में परिवर्तन और विकृति में परिवर्तन के बीच संबंध देता है।
      • \n\t
    • प्रयोगात्मक रूप से, यह धीरे-धीरे प्रणाली पर भार लागू करके प्राप्त किया जाता है।
      • \n\t
    • प्रतिबल और विकृति का अनुपात यंग का प्रत्यास्थता गुणांक देता है।
      • \n
    \n\n
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • आनुपातिकता की सीमा वह प्रतिबल है जिस पर प्रतिबल-विकृति वक्र एक सीधी रेखा में नहीं रहती है। यह प्रतिबल है जिस पर विस्तार विकृति के आनुपातिक होना बंद हो जाता है। आनुपातिक सीमा महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि प्रत्यास्थ निकायों के व्यवहार से जुड़े सभी सिद्धांत प्रतिबल-विकृति आनुपातिकता पर आधारित हैं।
      • \n\t
    • \n\t

      प्रत्यास्थता सीमा प्रतिबल-विकृति वक्र में वह बिंदु है जिस तक सामग्री प्रत्यास्थ रहती है, यानी सामग्री भार को हटाने के बाद अपनी आकृति प्राप्त करती है।

      \n\n\t

    \n\n16d:T3103,\nKey Points\n\n

    హుక్ నియమం:

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • ప్రత్యక్ష లోడ్ కింద, అనుపాత పరిమితిలో, ఒత్తిడి నేరుగా స్ట్రెయిన్ కి అనులోమానుపాతంలో ఉంటుందని పేర్కొంది.
      • \n\t
    • సాగదీయబడిన వస్తువు సాగదీయబడినప్పుడు లేదా కుదించబడినప్పుడు ఎలా ప్రవర్తిస్తుందో అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి హుక్ యొక్క నియమం మనకు సహాయపడుతుంది.
      • \n\t
      • \n
    \n\n

    ఒత్తిడి ∝ స్ట్రెయిన్

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • σ = E × ∈
      • \n\t
    • ఇక్కడ σ అనేది ఒత్తిడి, ∈ అనేది స్ట్రెయిన్, E అనేది స్థిరమైన అనుపాతత మరియు యంగ్ యొక్క స్థితిస్థాపకత మాడ్యులస్ అని పిలుస్తారు.
      • \n
    \n\n

    యంగ్ యొక్క స్థితిస్థాపకత మాడ్యులస్

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • స్ట్రెస్-స్ట్రెయిన్ కర్వ్ యొక్క వాలును స్థితిస్థాపకత మాడ్యులస్ (E) అంటారు.
      • \n\t
    • స్థితిస్థాపకత యొక్క మాడ్యులస్ (E) అనేది అనుపాతత యొక్క స్థిరాంకం, ఇది యూనిట్ ఒత్తిడికి కారణమయ్యే ఒత్తిడి యొక్క తీవ్రతగా నిర్వచించబడింది.
      • \n\t
    • స్థితిస్థాపకత యొక్క మాడ్యులస్ (E) ఒత్తిడికి సమానమైన యూనిట్‌ను కలిగి ఉంటుంది.
      • \n
    \n\n

    హుక్ యొక్క చట్టం పరిమితి అనుపాతం వరకు చెల్లుతుంది.

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • తేలికపాటి ఉక్కు కోసం దామాషా పరిమితి మరియు సాగే పరిమితి దాదాపు సమానంగా ఉంటాయి.
      • \n\t
    • ఇతర లోహాల కోసం, సాగే పరిమితి అనుపాత పరిమితి కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉండవచ్చు. ఉదా రబ్బరు.
      • \n
    \n\n

        हुकचा नियम:

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • यानुसार, थेट भारांतर्गत, समानुपातिकतेच्या मर्यादेत, दाब हा ताणाच्या समानुपाती असतो.
          • \n\t
        • हूकचा नियम, आपल्याला हे समजण्यास मदत करतो की, एखादी ताणलेली वस्तू जेव्हा ती आणखी ताणली जाते किंवा संकुचित केली जाते, तेव्हा ती कशी वर्तन करेल.
          • \n\t

        दाब ∝ ताण

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • σ = E × ∈
          • \n\t
        • येथे σ हा दाब आहे, ∈ हा ताण आहे, E हा समानुपातिकता स्थिरांक आहे, ज्याला यंगचा स्थितीस्थापकता मापांक म्हणून ओळखले जाते.
          • \n
        \n\n

        यंगचा स्थितीस्थापकता मापांक

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • दाब-ताण वक्राच्या उताराला स्थितीस्थापकता मापांक (E) म्हणतात.
          • \n\t
        • स्थितीस्थापकता मापांक (E) हा समानुपातिकतेचा स्थिरांक आहे, ज्याची व्याख्या दाबाची तीव्रता म्हणून केली जाते, ज्यामुळे एकक ताण उद्भवतो.
          • \n\t
        • स्थितीस्थापकता मापांकाचे (E) एकक दाबासारखेच असते.
          • \n
        \n\n

        हूकचा नियम समानुपातिकता मर्यादेपर्यंत वैध आहे.

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • मृदु पोलादासाठी समानुपातिकतेनुसार मर्यादा आणि स्थितीस्थापकता मर्यादा जवळजवळ समान असते.
          • \n\t

        \n\n

        दाब-ताण वक्र:

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • एखाद्या सामग्रीसाठी दाब-ताण वक्र हा दाबातील बदल आणि ताणातील बदल यांच्यातील संबंध प्रदान करतो.
          • \n\t
        • प्रायोगिकरित्या, हे हळूहळू प्रणालीवर भार लागू करून प्राप्त केले जाते.
          • \n\t
        • दाब आणि ताण यांचे गुणोत्तर यंगचा स्थितीस्थापकता मापांक प्रदान करतो.
          • \n\t
          • \n\t
        • \n\t

          समानुपातिकता मर्यादा हा असा दाब आहे, ज्यावर दाब-ताण वक्र एका सरळ रेषेत राहणे बंद होते. हा असा दाब आहे, ज्यावर विस्तार हा ताणाच्या प्रमाणात असणे थांबवते. समानुपातिकता मर्यादा महत्त्वाची आहे, कारण स्थितीस्थापक शरीराच्या वर्तनाचा समावेश असलेले सर्व त्यानंतरचे सिद्धांत दाब-ताणांच्या समानुपातिकतेवर आधारित आहेत.

          \n\n\t

          स्थितीस्थापक मर्यादा म्हणजे दाब-ताण वक्रामधील असा बिंदू, ज्यापर्यंत सामग्री स्थितीस्थापक राहते, म्हणजे भार काढून टाकल्यानंतर सामग्री पुन्हा आपला मूळ आकार प्राप्त करते.

          \n\t
          • \n
        \n\n16f:T3dc3,\n গুরুত্বপূর্ণ দিক

        হুকের আইন:

        • এটি বলে যে সরাসরি লোডিংয়ের অধীনে, আনুপাতিকতার সীমার মধ্যে, স্ট্রেস সরাসরি স্ট্রেনের সমানুপাতিক।
        • হুকের সূত্র আমাদের বুঝতে সাহায্য করে যে একটি প্রসারিত বস্তু যখন প্রসারিত বা সংকুচিত হয় তখন কীভাবে আচরণ করবে।

        স্ট্রেস ∝ স্ট্রেন

        • σ = E × ∈
        • যেখানে σ হল স্ট্রেস, ∈ হল স্ট্রেন, E হল সমানুপাতিকতার একটি ধ্রুবক এবং স্থিতিস্থাপকতার ইয়ং মডুলাস হিসাবে পরিচিত।

        ইয়াং এর স্থিতিস্থাপকতার মডুলাস

        • স্ট্রেস-স্ট্রেন বক্ররেখার ঢালকে স্থিতিস্থাপকতার মডুলাস (E) বলা হয়।
        • স্থিতিস্থাপকতার মডুলাস (E) হল সমানুপাতিকতার ধ্রুবক যা চাপের তীব্রতা হিসাবে সংজ্ঞায়িত করা হয় যা ইউনিট স্ট্রেন সৃষ্টি করে।
        • স্থিতিস্থাপকতার মডুলাস (E) এর একক চাপের মতোই রয়েছে।

        হুকের আইন সীমা সমানুপাতিকতা পর্যন্ত বৈধ।

        • হালকা ইস্পাতের জন্য আনুপাতিক সীমা এবং ইলাস্টিক সীমা প্রায় সমান।
        • অন্যান্য ধাতুগুলির জন্য, স্থিতিস্থাপক সীমা আনুপাতিকতার সীমার চেয়ে বেশি হতে পারে। যেমন রাবার।

          চাপ আলিঙ্গন বক্ররেখা:

          • একটি উপাদানের জন্য স্ট্রেস-স্ট্রেন বক্ররেখা চাপের পরিবর্তন এবং স্ট্রেনের পরিবর্তনের মধ্যে সম্পর্ক দেয়।
          • পরীক্ষামূলকভাবে, এটি ধীরে ধীরে সিস্টেমে একটি লোড প্রয়োগ করে প্রাপ্ত হয়।
          • স্ট্রেস এবং স্ট্রেনের অনুপাত ইয়ং এর মডুলাসকে স্থিতিস্থাপকতা দেয়।

          • সমানুপাতিকতার সীমা হল সেই স্ট্রেস যেখানে স্ট্রেস-স্ট্রেন বক্ররেখাটি সরলরেখা থেকে বন্ধ হয়ে যায়। এটি এমন চাপ যেখানে এক্সটেনশন স্ট্রেনের সমানুপাতিক হওয়া বন্ধ করে দেয়। আনুপাতিক সীমা গুরুত্বপূর্ণ কারণ স্থিতিস্থাপক দেহের আচরণ জড়িত পরবর্তী সমস্ত তত্ত্ব স্ট্রেস-স্ট্রেন সমানুপাতিকতার উপর ভিত্তি করে।

            স্থিতিস্থাপক সীমা হ'ল স্ট্রেস-স্ট্রেন বক্ররেখার সেই বিন্দু যেখানে উপাদানটি স্থিতিস্থাপক থাকে, অর্থাৎ লোড অপসারণের পরে উপাদানটি তার আকার ফিরে পায়। ϵ=∆ll\" role=\"presentation\" style=\"display: inline; line-height: normal; word-spacing: normal; overflow-wrap: normal; white-space: nowrap; float: none; direction: ltr; max-width: none; max-height: none; min-width: 0px; min-height: 0px; border: 0px; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; position: relative;\" tabindex=\"0\">

          \n\n170:T326b,\nKey Points\n\n

          હૂકનો નિયમ:

          \n\n
            \n\t
          • તે જણાવે છે કે ડાયરેક્ટ લોડિંગ હેઠળ, પ્રમાણસરતા મર્યાદાની અંદર, તાણ વિકૃતિના સીધા પ્રમાણસર છે.
            • \n\t
          • હૂકનો નિયમ અમને એ સમજવામાં મદદ કરે છે કે જ્યારે ખેંચાયેલી વસ્તુ ખેંચાય અથવા સંકુચિત હોય ત્યારે તે કેવી રીતે વર્તે છે.
            • \n\t
            • \n
          \n\n

          તાણ ∝ વિકૃતિ

          \n\n
            \n\t
          • σ = E × ∈
            • \n\t
          • જ્યાં σ એ તાણ છે, ∈ એ વિકૃતિ છે, E એ પ્રમાણસરતાનો અચળ છે અને યંગના સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતાના મોડ્યુલસ તરીકે ઓળખાય છે.
            • \n
          \n\n

          યંગનું સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતાનું મોડ્યુલસ

          \n\n
            \n\t
          • તાણ-વિકૃતિ વળાંકની ઢાળને સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતાનું મોડ્યુલસ (E) કહેવામાં આવે છે.
            • \n\t
          • સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતાનું મોડ્યુલસ (E) એ પ્રમાણસરતાનું સ્થિરાંક છે જે તણાવની તીવ્રતા તરીકે વ્યાખ્યાયિત થાય છે જે એકમ વિકૃતિનું કારણ બને છે.
            • \n\t
          • સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતાના મોડ્યુલસ (E) નું એકમ તાણ જેવું જ છે.
            • \n
          \n\n

          હૂકનો નિયમ પ્રમાણસરતાની મર્યાદા સુધી માન્ય છે.

          \n\n
            \n\t
          • હળવા સ્ટીલ માટે પ્રમાણસર મર્યાદા અને સ્થિતિસ્થાપક મર્યાદા લગભગ સમાન છે.
            • \n\t
          • અન્ય ધાતુઓ માટે, સ્થિતિસ્થાપક મર્યાદા પ્રમાણસરતા મર્યાદા કરતા વધારે હોઈ શકે છે. દા.ત. રબર.
            • \n
          \n\n

          Additional Information

          \n\n

          તાણ:

          \n\n
            \n\t
          • બળ (F) પ્રતિ એકમ ક્ષેત્રફળ (A) લાગુ પડે છે તેને તાણ કહેવામાં આવે છે.Key Points\n\n

              • \n\t
            • હૂકનો નિયમ અમને એ સમજવામાં મદદ કરે છે કે જ્યારે ખેંચાયેલી વસ્તુ ખેંચાય અથવા સંકુચિત હોય ત્યારે તે કેવી રીતે વર્તે છે.

            \n\n
              \n\t

            • જ્યાં σ એ તાણ છે, ∈ એ વિકૃતિ છે, E એ પ્રમાણસરતાનો અચળ છે અને યંગના સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતાના મોડ્યુલસ તરીકે ઓળખાય છે.
              • \n

            યંગનું સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતાનું મોડ્યુલસ

            \n\n
              \n\t
            • તાણ-વિકૃતિ વળાંકની ઢાળને સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતાનું મોડ્યુલસ (E) કહેવામાં આવે છે.
              • \n\t
            • સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતાનું મોડ્યુલસ (E) એ પ્રમાણસરતાનું સ્થિરાંક છે જે તણાવની તીવ્રતા તરીકે વ્યાખ્યાયિત થાય છે જે એકમ વિકૃતિનું કારણ બને છે.
              • \n\t
            • સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતાના મોડ્યુલસ (E) નું એકમ તાણ જેવું જ છે.
              • \n
            \n\n

            હૂકનો નિયમ પ્રમાણસરતાની મર્યાદા સુધી માન્ય છે.

            \n\n
              \n\t
            • હળવા સ્ટીલ માટે પ્રમાણસર મર્યાદા અને સ્થિતિસ્થાપક મર્યાદા લગભગ સમાન છે.
              • \n\t
            • અન્ય ધાતુઓ માટે, સ્થિતિસ્થાપક મર્યાદા પ્રમાણસરતા મર્યાદા કરતા વધારે હોઈ શકે છે. દા.ત. રબર.
              • \n
            \n\n

            Additional Information

            \n\n

            તાણ:

            \n\n
              \n\t
            • બળ (F) પ્રતિ એકમ ક્ષેત્રફળ (A) લાગુ પડે છે તેને તાણ કહેવામાં આવે છે. σ = એફ
              • \n\t
            • તાણનો એકમ: N/m 2 .
              • \n\t
            • σ = F/A
              • \n
            \n\n

            વિકૃતિ:

            \n\n
              \n\t
            • પદાર્થના પ્રારંભિક પરિમાણો (l) દ્વારા વિભાજિત બળની દિશામાં પદાર્થ દ્વારા અનુભવાયેલ વિરૂપતાના માપ (Δl) ને તાણ કહેવામાં આવે છે.
              • \n\t
            • ϵ = Δl/l Δ એલ
              • \n
            \n\n

             

            \n\n

            તાણ-વિકૃતિ વળાંક:

            \n\n
              \n\t
            • સામગ્રી માટે તાણ-વિકૃતિ વળાંક તણાવમાં ફેરફાર અને વિકૃતિમાં ફેરફાર વચ્ચેનો સંબંધ આપે છે.
              • \n\t
            • પ્રાયોગિક રીતે, તે તંત્ર પર ધીમે ધીમે લોડ લાગુ કરીને મેળવવામાં આવે છે.
              • \n\t
            • તાણ અને વિકૃતિનો ગુણોત્તર યંગના મોડ્યુલસને સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતા આપે છે.
              • \n\t
              • \n\t
            • \n\t

              પ્રમાણસરતાની મર્યાદા એ તણાવ છે કે જેના પર તાણ-વિકૃતિ વળાંક સીધી રેખા તરીકે બંધ થઈ જાય છે. તે તાણ છે કે જેના પર વિસ્તરણ તાણના પ્રમાણસર થવાનું બંધ કરે છે. પ્રમાણસર મર્યાદા મહત્વપૂર્ણ છે કારણ કે સ્થિતિસ્થાપક પદાર્થના વર્તનને સંડોવતા તમામ અનુગામી સિદ્ધાંત તણાવ-તાણના પ્રમાણ પર આધારિત છે.

              \n\n\t

              સ્થિતિસ્થાપક મર્યાદા એ તણાવ-તાણ વળાંકમાં તે બિંદુ છે જ્યાં સુધી સામગ્રી સ્થિતિસ્થાપક રહે છે, એટલે કે ભાર દૂર કર્યા પછી સામગ્રી તેનો આકાર પાછો મેળવે છે.\\(x = {-b \\pm \\sqrt{b^2-4ac} \\over 2a}\\)

              \n\t
              • \n
            \n\n171:T3f94,\n ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳು

            ಹುಕ್ ಕಾನೂನು:

            • ನೇರ ಲೋಡಿಂಗ್ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಪ್ರಮಾಣಾನುಗುಣ ಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗೆ, ಒತ್ತಡವು ಒತ್ತಡಕ್ಕೆ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಅದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
            • ಹಿಗ್ಗಿಸಲಾದ ವಸ್ತುವು ವಿಸ್ತರಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅಥವಾ ಸಂಕುಚಿತಗೊಂಡಾಗ ಅದು ಹೇಗೆ ವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಹುಕ್‌ನ ನಿಯಮವು ನಮಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

            ಒತ್ತಡ ∝ ಸ್ಟ್ರೈನ್

            • σ = E × ∈
            • ಇಲ್ಲಿ σ ಎಂಬುದು ಒತ್ತಡ, ∈ ಎಂಬುದು ಸ್ಟ್ರೈನ್, E ಎಂಬುದು ಅನುಪಾತದ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಇದನ್ನು ಯಂಗ್‌ನ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕತ್ವದ ಮಾಡ್ಯುಲಸ್ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

            ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕತ್ವದ ಯಂಗ್ ಮಾಡ್ಯುಲಸ್

            • ಒತ್ತಡ-ಸ್ಟ್ರೈನ್ ಕರ್ವ್ನ ಇಳಿಜಾರನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕತ್ವದ ಮಾಡ್ಯುಲಸ್ (E) ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
            • ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕತ್ವದ ಮಾಡ್ಯುಲಸ್ (ಇ) ಅನುಪಾತದ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ, ಇದು ಘಟಕದ ಒತ್ತಡವನ್ನು ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುವ ಒತ್ತಡದ ತೀವ್ರತೆ ಎಂದು ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.
            • ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕತ್ವದ ಮಾಡ್ಯುಲಸ್ (E) ಒತ್ತಡದ ಘಟಕವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.

            ಹುಕ್‌ನ ಕಾನೂನು ಮಿತಿಯ ಅನುಪಾತದವರೆಗೆ ಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

            • ಸೌಮ್ಯವಾದ ಉಕ್ಕಿನ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಾನುಗುಣವಾಗಿ ಮಿತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕ ಮಿತಿ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಸಮಾನವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.
            • ಇತರ ಲೋಹಗಳಿಗೆ, ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕ ಮಿತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಾನುಗುಣ ಮಿತಿಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿರಬಹುದು. ಉದಾ ರಬ್ಬರ್.

              ಸ್ಟ್ರೆಸ್-ಸ್ಟ್ರೈನ್ ಕರ್ವ್:

              • ವಸ್ತುವಿನ ಒತ್ತಡ-ಸ್ಟ್ರೈನ್ ಕರ್ವ್ ಒತ್ತಡದಲ್ಲಿನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಒತ್ತಡದಲ್ಲಿನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
              • ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕವಾಗಿ, ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್ಗೆ ಕ್ರಮೇಣ ಲೋಡ್ ಅನ್ನು ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವ ಮೂಲಕ ಇದನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

                ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕ ಮಿತಿ ಎಂದರೆ ಒತ್ತಡ-ಸ್ಟ್ರೈನ್ ಕರ್ವ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ವಸ್ತುವು ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕವಾಗಿ ಉಳಿಯುವ ಬಿಂದುವಾಗಿದೆ, ಅಂದರೆ ಲೋಡ್ ಅನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕಿದ ನಂತರ ವಸ್ತುವು ಅದರ ಆಕಾರವನ್ನು ಮರಳಿ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ϵ=∆ll\" role=\"presentation\" style=\"display: inline; line-height: normal; word-spacing: normal; overflow-wrap: normal; white-space: nowrap; float: none; direction: ltr; max-width: none; max-height: none; min-width: 0px; min-height: 0px; border: 0px; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; position: relative;\" tabindex=\"0\">

              \n\n172:T323f,\nKey Points \n\n

              ஹூக்கின் விதி:

              \n\n
                \n\t
              • நேரடி சுமையின் கீழ், விகிதாச்சார வரம்பிற்குள், அழுத்தம் திரிபுக்கு நேர் விகிதமாக இருக்கும் என்று அது கூறுகிறது.
                • \n\t
              • ஹூக்கின் விதியானது, நீட்டிக்கப்படும் அல்லது சுருக்கப்பட்டால், நீட்டிக்கப்படும் பொருள் எவ்வாறு செயல்படும் என்பதைப் புரிந்துகொள்ள உதவுகிறது.

                    सही उत्तर सोम प्रकाश है।

                    \n\n

                    Key Points

                    \n\n
                      \n\t
                    • मंत्रिमंडल में फेरबदल के बाद नई मंत्रिपरिषद की औसत आयु 61 साल से घटकर 58 साल हो गई है।
                      • \n\t
                    • पश्चिम बंगाल के कूचबिहार से लोकसभा सांसद निसिथ प्रमाणिक (35) शपथ लेने वाले सबसे युवा मंत्री हैं, जबकि मंत्रिपरिषद में सबसे उम्रदराज सदस्य 72 वर्षीय सोम प्रकाश हैं।
                      • \n\t
                    • मंत्रिपरिषद में अब 77 सदस्य हैं।
                      • \n
                    \n\n

                    Important Points

                    \n\n
                      \n\t
                    • मंत्रिपरिषद:\n\n\t
                        \n\t\t
                      • मंत्रिपरिषद की नियुक्ति राष्ट्रपति द्वारा प्रधानमंत्री की सलाह पर की जाती है।
                        • \n\t\t
                      • आमतौर पर, केवल संसद के सदस्यों को मंत्री के रूप में नियुक्त किया जाता है।
                        • \n\t\t
                      • मंत्रिपरिषद में मंत्रियों के सभी क्रम अर्थात कैबिनेट मंत्रि, राज्य मंत्रि और उप मंत्रि सम्मिलित होते हैं।
                        • \n\t
                      \n\t
                      • \n
                    \n\n

                    Additional Information

                    \n\n
                      \n\t
                    • निसिथ प्रमाणिक:\n\n\t
                        \n\t\t
                      • कूचबिहार के 35 वर्षीय निसिथ प्रमाणिक मोदी के मंत्रिपरिषद में सबसे कम उम्र के मंत्री हैं।
                        • \n\t\t
                      • उनकी असली उपलब्धि कूचबिहार को कोलकाता की छाया से बाहर लाने और इसे राष्ट्रीय मानचित्र पर लाने में निहित है।
                        • \n\t
                      \n\t
                      • \n\t
                    • सुदर्शन भगत:\n\t
                        \n\t\t
                      • वह भारतीय जनता पार्टी से संबंधित एक सक्रिय भारतीय राजनीतिज्ञ हैं।
                        • \n\t\t
                      • वह भारतीय संसद के सदस्य हैं, और वर्तमान में लोहरदगा निर्वाचन क्षेत्र का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं।
                        • \n\t\t
                      • वह नरेंद्र मोदी सरकार में जनजातीय मामलों के राज्य मंत्री हैं।
                        • \n\t
                      \n\t
                      • \n\t
                    • पीपी चौधरी:\n\t
                        \n\t\t
                      • पी.पी. चौधरी केंद्रीय कानून और न्याय राज्य मंत्री और कॉर्पोरेट मामलों के मंत्रालय हैं।
                        • \n\t\t
                      • इससे पहले, चौधरी लाभ की सेवाओं पर संयुक्त संसदीय समिति के अध्यक्ष थे और अधीनस्थ विधान समिति और कार्मिक, लोक शिकायत, कानून और न्याय पर स्थायी समिति के सदस्य भी थे।

                          The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

                          \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "you will be playing&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "By this time tomorrow,"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "for 48 hours"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "the violin&nbsp;"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                          The erroneous part of the sentence is: you will be playing 

                          \n\n

                          Key Points

                          \n\n
                            \n\t
                          • The error lies in the use of the future continuous tense ("will be playing") in this context. It doesn't make sense to use the future continuous tense when specifying a duration of time.
                            • \n\t
                          • We use the future perfect tense ("will have been playing") to indicate an action that will start in the future (tomorrow) and continue up to a specific point in the future.
                            • \n\t
                          • This tense is appropriate because it aligns with the timeframe mentioned in the sentence.
                            • \n\t
                          • The original sentence attempted to convey the idea of playing the violin for a specified duration (48 hours). However, using the future continuous tense ("will be playing") in this context would imply an ongoing action without specifying the duration.
                            • \n\t
                          • The corrected sentence, "By this time tomorrow, you will have been playing the violin for 48 hours," is grammatically accurate and conveys a specific sense of time and duration.
                            • \n
                          \n\n

                          Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

The wedding planner is making all the reservations and arrangements in advance. ", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "All the reservations and arrangements are to be made by the wedding planner in advance.&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "All the reservations and arrangements are being made by the wedding planner in advance.&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "All the reservations and arrangements are being making by the wedding planner in advance.&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "All the reservations and arrangements are made by the wedding planner in advance."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                          The correct answer is: "All the reservations and arrangements are being made by the wedding planner in advance."

                          \n\n

                          Key Points

                          \n\n
                            \n\t
                          • Identify the subject, verb, and object in the active sentence.\n\t
                              \n\t\t

                              • \n\t\t
                            • Verb: is making
                              • \n\t\t
                            • Object: all the reservations and arrangements in advance
                              • \n\t
                            \n\t
                            • \n\t
                          • Move the object of the active sentence to the beginning of the passive sentence.
                            • \n\t
                          • Object (from the active sentence): all the reservations and arrangements in advance
                            • \n\t
                          • Use the appropriate form of the auxiliary verb "to be" (in this case, "are being") based on the tense of the active verb ("is making").
                            • \n\t
                          • Add the past participle form of the active verb ("made").
                            • \n\t
                          • Include the agent (the doer of the action), which is "by the wedding planner."
                            • \n\t
                          • Following these rules, we transform the sentence into passive voice: "All the reservations and arrangements are being made by the wedding planner in advance."
                            • \n
                          \n\n

                                                          • In English grammar, plural subjects require plural verbs. However, the rule changes when plural subjects are connected using "and", and it is taken as a collective noun or a single entity.
                                                            • \n\t

                                                                  Select the option that gives the most appropriate meaning of the following word.

                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  Solicit

                                                                  \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Pretend"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Degrade"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Request"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Complicate"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                  The correct answer is: Request.
                                                                  \n
                                                                  \nKey Points

                                                                  \n\n
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                  • Solicit means to ask for or seek something, often in a formal or earnest manner. (कुछ माँगना, अक्सर औपचारिक या गंभीर तरीके से)
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • It can also mean trying to obtain something from someone.\n\t
                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                    • For example: The charity organization is soliciting donations for the flood victims.
                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Marked option Request means to ask for something politely or formally. (विनम्रतापूर्वक या औपचारिक रूप से कुछ माँगना)\n\t
                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                    • For example: I would like to kindly request an extension for the deadline on my project to ensure I can deliver my best work.
                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                    • \n
                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  Additional Information

                                                                  \n\n
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                  • Pretend: to behave in a way that is not genuine or true. (इस तरह से व्यवहार करना जो वास्तविक या सच्चा नहीं है)
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Degrade: to lower in dignity or honour; to reduce in rank or status. (गरिमा या सम्मान में कमी करना; पद या पद में कमी करना)
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Complicate: to make something more difficult or confusing. (किसी चीज़ को अधिक कठिन या भ्रमित करने वाला बनाना)
                                                                    • \n

                                                                  The correct answer is: "She told me that she had been thinking of going out for dinner but changed her mind later on."

                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  Key Points

                                                                  \n\n
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                  • Indirect speech requires a change in tense and pronouns.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Reporting Verb: In this case, the reporting verb is "said." When reporting speech indirectly, it's changed to "told."
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Pronouns: The pronouns need to be adjusted to fit the new context. "I" becomes "she" (the original speaker), and "me" becomes "me" (the listener).
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Tense Change: The verb tense changes to reflect that the reported speech is in the past. "Was thinking" becomes "had been thinking," and "had changed" remains the same.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Reporting Clause: The original sentence is introduced by "She said to me." In indirect speech, this can be replaced with "She told me that..."
                                                                    • \n
                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  Additional Information

                                                                  \n\n
                                                                    \n\t

                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Option 2 changes the tense correctly, but changes the meaning by using "she thought of going out" instead of "she was thinking of going out."
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Option 3 changes the pronouns correctly, but incorrectly states that "I" was thinking of going out.
                                                                    • \n

                                                                  The correct answer is: Produce.

                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  Key Points

                                                                  \n\n
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                  • Yield means to produce or provide, often used in the context of crops or profits. (उत्पादन या प्रदान करना, अक्सर फसलों या मुनाफ़े के संदर्भ में उपयोग किया जाता है)

                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                    • \n

                                                                    \n\t

                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Bring means to carry or move something or someone to a place. (किसी वस्तु या व्यक्ति को किसी स्थान पर ले जाना या ले जाना)
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Build means to construct or create something, often a physical structure. (किसी चीज़ का निर्माण या निर्माण करना, अक्सर एक भौतिक संरचना)
                                                                    • \n
                                                                  \n\n1ae:Tade,\n

                                                                  The correct answer is: "Lemon is sour when it is tasted."

                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  Lemon tastes sour. 

                                                                  \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Lemon has been tasted sour."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Lemon is tasted sour.&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Lemon is sour when it is tasted.&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Lemon has been sour when tasted.&nbsp;"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                  The correct answer is: "Lemon is sour when it is tasted."

                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  Key Points

                                                                  \n\n
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                  • The sentence is in active voice, with "Lemon" as the subject and "tastes" as the verb.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • In the passive voice, the object of the active verb becomes the subject of the passive verb, and the active subject is either omitted or introduced with "by."
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • To make the sentence passive, we need to say "Lemon is tasted" and add "by someone" or "by people" to indicate who is doing the tasting.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • However, the sentence doesn't really make sense in the passive voice, because we don't typically talk about lemons being tasted by someone else. It makes more sense to keep the sentence in the active voice.
                                                                    • \n
                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.

                                                                  \n\n


                                                                  \nAdditional Information

                                                                  \n\n
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                  • "Lemon has been tasted sour," is grammatically correct but doesn't make sense in this context. It suggests that someone tasted a lemon and found it to be sour, but that doesn't tell us anything about the lemon itself.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • "Lemon is tasted sour," is grammatically incorrect because it doesn't include a subject for the verb "is tasted."
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • "Lemon has been sour when tasted," is grammatically correct but awkwardly phrased. It suggests that lemons are sometimes sour and sometimes not, depending on when they are tasted.
                                                                    • \n

                                                                  Key Points

                                                                  Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  It is your duty to help the poor people in your parish. 

                                                                  \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "The poor people in your parish are to be helped by you.&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "It is suggested that you do your duty to help the poor in your parish.&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "The poor people in the parish are helped by you as duty.&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "You may be allowed to help the poor people in your parish.&nbsp;"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is "The poor people in your parish are to be helped by you."
                                                                  \n
                                                                  \n Key Points\n\n
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                  • The given sentence is in Active Voice.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • As per the given question, we have to change it to Passive Voice.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • The structure of the given sentence is as follows:\n\t
                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                    • It + is + Subject + duty + to V1 + Object. (Active Voice)
                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                    • Subject (objective case)+ is/am/are + to be V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Example:\n\t
                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                    • It is my duty to assist my partner. (Active Voice)
                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                    • My partner is to be assisted by me. (Passive Voice)
                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • The sentence is in active voice with the subject "you" performing the action of helping.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • To convert it into passive voice, we need to make the object (poor people in your parish) the subject and use the auxiliary verb "to be" along with the past participle form of the main verb (helped).
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • The preposition "by" is used to indicate the doer of the action (you).
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.
                                                                    \n\t​
                                                                    • \n
                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  Correct sentence: The poor people in your parish are to be helped by you. 

                                                                  \n\n", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Grammar"], "concept": "Grammar", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "63826927a427aa811dedb6b7", "qs_no": 72, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "

                                                                  Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

                                                                  \n\n

                                                                  The boy said to the teacher, "Sir, I am weak in Maths and seek your advice."

                                                                  \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "The boy told the teacher that he was weak in Maths and seek his advice.&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "The boy told the teacher that he was weak in Maths and sought his advice."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "The boy told the teacher that he is weak in Maths and see his advice.&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "The boy told that he was weak in Maths and sought his advice.&nbsp;"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is "The boy told the teacher that he was weak in Maths and sought his advice."
                                                                  \n
                                                                  \n Key Points\n\n
                                                                    \n\t
                                                                  • The given sentence is in the Simple Present Tense. 
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Indirect speech requires a change in tense, pronouns, and adverbs.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • The reporting verb said/said to is changed in asked, demanded, ordered, exclaimed and enquired as per the nature of the sentence.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • The conjunction 'that' will be used.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • The first person in the reported speech changes according to the subject of the reporting speech.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • In Reported Speech, the change of the second person depends on the object of reporting speech.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • The third person remains unchanged.
                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                  • Simple Present Tense 'is' converted into Simple Past Tense 'was'.
                                                                    • \n\t

                                                                      • In indirect speech, the verb tense often changes from present to past and from past to past perfect.
                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                      • 'Cannot' changes to 'Could not.'

                                                                      • The reporting verb said/said to is changed to told, asked, demanded, ordered, and enquired as per the nature of the sentence.
                                                                        • \n\t

                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                      • The first person in the reported speech changes according to the subject of the reporting speech.

                                                                      • We must use 'that' in the sentence of indirect speech.
                                                                        • \n\t
